responsibility: Holds the primary RTL machine description for the MicroBlaze port. It defines instruction patterns, expanders, unspec codes, attributes, scheduling/pipeline descriptions, call and return forms, PIC/GOT setup sequences, traps, CLZ, EH return expansion, and other insn recognizers and output templates that drive instruction selection and final assembly emission, while including the port’s predicate, constraint, and synchronization sub-descriptions.
same_name_distinction: This is the RTL machine-description file for MicroBlaze, written in GCC's .md language: it defines insn patterns, expanders, attributes, unspecs, and pipeline/scheduling descriptions such as call, trap, GOT, CLZ, and EH-return forms. Unlike microblaze.cc it is not the C++ hook implementation layer, unlike microblaze.h it is not the target macro/spec header, and unlike microblaze.opt it does not declare user-facing options.
